trailhead.label: The car park of the St. Martin im Kofel cable car in Latsch, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
Steep path 7 up to the plateau: knees and paws work hard.
Crosses the main road at the roundabout near the start: lead on and cross with care.
Suspension bridge over the Tiss gorge: some dogs need coaxing.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Steep path 7 up to the plateau: knees an: Ripido sentiero 7 fino all'altopiano: ginocchia e zampe faticano.
textIt.Crosses the main road at the roundabout: Attraversa la strada principale alla rotonda vicino alla partenza: guinzaglio e attraversa con attenzione.
textIt.Suspension bridge over the Tiss gorge: s: Ponte sospeso sulla gola di Tiss: alcuni cani vanno incoraggiati.
